card.text: M67 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 837 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_2682: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 837.26777331 pc (16th to 84th percentile 837 to 838)
Wikipedia, "Messier 67"
sources.quote: Messier 67 and sometimes called the King Cobra Cluster or the Golden Eye Cluster is an open cluster in the southern, equatorial half of Cancer.

introduction.text: M67 is drawn as 806 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
